summary: Control flow, loop forms and grid generality implemented and validated. (1) TIR/lowering: runtime if/else with explicit join parameters (a one-path re-bind becomes a fresh block parameter, never a lexical restore), counted loops (range/tl.range with step; every pragma parameter classified ignorable-with-reason and recorded), tl.static_range compile-time unrolling, while loops with a carried condition, multi-axis program_id decomposition (axis-k divisor = product of extents 0..k-1), tl.num_programs from the runtime grid extents, persistent grid-stride while patterns and if_pid branches. The lowering builds the MIR CFG with block parameters as joins (scalar.py control-flow core), flattens ptradd chains into whole-tree addresses, opens the vector chunk region at the first block-level statement (source regions nest inside it, so block values carried across a source loop stay chunk-local), emits per-block vsetvli regions, and the allocator now prevents mixed-LMUL source/destination group overlap (a probe-found illegal-instruction form, asserted post-allocation). Fixed two pre-existing frontend bugs the control-flow path exposed: comparison operand-order inversion for literal-on-the-right compares (flag > 0 folded to 0 > flag) and RuntimeValue == folding to False instead of NOT_CONSTEXPR (if pid == 0 silently dropped the arm). (2) a100c/frontend/gridmodel.py: the provenance-tracking case-layer interpreter extracts every corpus grid form (multi-axis tuples, triton.cdiv products, lambda-meta with autotune configs folded as identity-tier constants, shape-derived locals, view extents via tracked array creation and a two-pass binding of opaque arrays, scalar-argument ties, min/max as MinMax nodes realized natively by a compare/mask/select sequence, np.ceil(a/b)), proves every leaf tied to a bundle-visible quantity (origin ties first, payload-shape value ties as a self-check-guarded fallback), and self-checks modeled == declared per compiling case. plan/grid.py is now a shim over it (the architecture places the model in the frontend). (3) Executed and compared under the declared QEMU endpoint at threads 1/2/4/8: the corpus operator var_len_copy (flow.loop + flow.dynamic_range, runtime-bound loop over a loaded length, scalar loads, view-extent grid tie) exact PASS on both shapes, plus synthetic operator-shaped kernels for every control-flow form (carried re-bind both branch directions, while + num_programs grid-stride, static_range + tl.range step/pragmas, 3x5 multi-axis decomposition with an axis-swapped negative control, if_pid, max()-gridded). Remaining flow-family corpus operators refuse with located diagnostics naming the first non-control-flow boundary (masked load other=, explicit casts, vector integer division, SEW!=32, 2-D arange indexing, early return) -- constructs owned by T009/T011/T012/T013 which the DAG sequences after T008; the 146 pat.persistent_reduce operators are untouched (T009). Grid census over all 2734 corpus cases: 2032 extracted with passing self-check, 702 refused with located diagnostics (323 genuinely-untied inputs, 177 untracked-axis values, 72 helper-built grids, 40 self-check mismatches caught loudly, 90 case-layer forms outside the model), recorded at a100c/cache/grid-census.json. Both task tests and the full 17-test suite pass.

Census over all 2734 corpus cases (500 operators, both tiers, the corpus's own enumeration): 2032 extracted, every one with the provenance self-check recording modeled == declared; 702 refused, every one with a located diagnostic naming the construct and the value (classes: 323 genuinely-untied bundle-invisible inputs, 177 axes consuming untracked values, 72 helper-function-built grids, 40 self-check mismatches refused loudly, 90 case-layer forms outside the model such as symbolic-bound loops). No silent baking: shape-dependent axes carry symbolic Ref leaves, and tampered declared grids refuse through the self-check. Census artifact: a100c/cache/grid-census.json

The carried-value re-bind case (a variable assigned on only one path of a branch, joined; a variable re-assigned twice in a loop, carried) executes correctly at threads 1, 2, 4 and 8 on both branch directions and both shapes with exact comparison. The lexical name-restore implementation is rejected by the TIR verifier: three hand-built witnesses (if-arm value used after the region without a join, a loop-carried entry the body never redefines, a while loop not carrying its condition) all reject with carried-value-without-join, and the with-join control verifies

A 3x5 two-axis grid decomposes program_id per axis correctly at threads 1/2/4/8: each element's value encodes both axes (p0*100 + p1), and the axis-swapped reference does NOT match (the decomposition is axis-distinguishing; the axis-k divisor is the product of the preceding extents). tl.num_programs reads the runtime grid extents, verified on the while grid-stride kernel (grid smaller than the blocks needed, stride from num_programs(0)) and on the multi-axis kernel reading num_programs(0)/num_programs(1)
